description: This plot illustrates the progression of two metrics, Ex1 Accuracy and Ex2 Accuracy, over a series of steps. The x-axis is labeled "Step" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60000, with tick marks at regular intervals of 10000. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (Next Token Prediction)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.10 to 0.40, with tick marks spaced every 0.05; the top tick label of 0.40 is highlighted with a gray background. The line representing Ex1 Accuracy is solid blue with circular markers. It begins at a value of approximately 0.09 at step 0, experiences a sharp increase to roughly 0.24 at step 1500, and continues to rise steeply to about 0.39 at step 7500. After this point, the line exhibits a steady, gradual upward trend, ending at approximately 0.41 at step 60000. The line representing Ex2 Accuracy is solid cyan with circular markers. It also starts at approximately 0.09 at step 0, rises sharply to about 0.27 at step 1500, and then increases more gradually to roughly 0.29 at step 13000. It then shows a moderate increase to approximately 0.36 at step 19000, followed by a steady, gradual rise, concluding at a value of approximately 0.39 at step 60000.
